statement: (let E := fun x : ℝ => Complex.exp (((2*Real.pi*x:ℝ):ℂ)*Complex.I); let S := fun (n : ℕ) (w : ℕ → ℝ) (t : ℝ) => Finset.sum (Finset.range (n+1)) (fun k => (w k:ℂ)*E ((k:ℝ)*t)); let Q := fun n : ℕ => (Nat.log 2 (n+2))^2; let arcs := fun n : ℕ => {t : ℝ | ∃ q a : ℕ, 1≤q ∧ q≤Q n ∧ a≤q ∧ Nat.Coprime a q ∧ |t-(a:ℝ)/(q:ℝ)| ≤ (Q n:ℝ)/((q:ℝ)*(n:ℝ))}; let L := fun n : ℕ => max 1 (Nat.log 2 n / 2); let K := fun (n : ℕ) (t : ℝ) => (∑ j ∈ Finset.range (L n), Real.cos (2*Real.pi*(2:ℝ)^(j+1)*t))/(L n:ℝ); let B := fun n : ℕ => {t : ℝ | t ∉ arcs n ∧ (1:ℝ)/2 < K n t}; let m := fun (s : Set ℝ) (f : ℝ → ℝ) => intervalIntegral (s.indicator f) (0:ℝ) 1 MeasureTheory.volume; ∃ N : ℕ, ∀ n ≥ N, Even n → m (B n) (fun t => ‖S n (fun k => ArithmeticFunction.vonMangoldt k) t‖^2) ≤ (n:ℝ)/640) → (let w := fun k : ℕ => if Nat.Prime k then Real.log (k:ℝ) else 0; let E := fun x : ℝ => Complex.exp (((2*Real.pi*x:ℝ):ℂ)*Complex.I); let S := fun (n : ℕ) (w : ℕ → ℝ) (t : ℝ) => Finset.sum (Finset.range (n+1)) (fun k => (w k:ℂ)*E ((k:ℝ)*t)); let Q := fun n : ℕ => (Nat.log 2 (n+2))^2; let arcs := fun n : ℕ => {t : ℝ | ∃ q a : ℕ, 1≤q ∧ q≤Q n ∧ a≤q ∧ Nat.Coprime a q ∧ |t-(a:ℝ)/(q:ℝ)| ≤ (Q n:ℝ)/((q:ℝ)*(n:ℝ))}; let low := fun (n k : ℕ) => if k^3≤n then w k else 0; let high := fun (n k : ℕ) => w k-low n k; let I := fun (n:ℕ) (a b:ℕ→ℝ) => intervalIntegral (fun t => (arcs n)ᶜ.indicator (fun u => S n a u*S n b u*E (-(n:ℝ)*u)) t) (0:ℝ) 1 MeasureTheory.volume; let L := fun n : ℕ => max 1 (Nat.log 2 n / 2); let K := fun (n : ℕ) (t : ℝ) => (∑ j ∈ Finset.range (L n), Real.cos (2*Real.pi*(2:ℝ)^(j+1)*t))/(L n:ℝ); let B := fun n : ℕ => {t : ℝ | t ∉ arcs n ∧ (1:ℝ)/2 < K n t}; let U := fun (n : ℕ) (a : ℕ → ℝ) => intervalIntegral ((B n).indicator (fun t => ‖S n a t‖^2)) (0:ℝ) 1 MeasureTheory.volume; ∃ N : ℕ, ∀ n ≥ N, Even n → U n (high n) ≤ (n:ℝ)/576)

plain_statement.en: Return from the full Mangoldt spectrum to resonant prime energy

brief.zh: 逐点用 (a+b)²≤(17/16)a²+17b² 控制交叉项。主谱取 n/640，平方误差取 n/10⁶；相加守住 n/576。
brief.en: Control the mixed term by (a+b)²≤(17/16)a²+17b². The main-spectrum allowance n/640 and squared-error allowance n/10⁶ fit within n/576.
